## Tillwise — desktop

Download the installer for your computer:

| Platform | File |
| --- | --- |
| Windows | `Tillwise-Setup-*.exe` |
| macOS | `Tillwise-*-*.dmg` |
| Linux | `Tillwise-*.AppImage` |

The desktop app and the website share the same database and the same login. A till can be
set up either way, and it keeps selling offline.

These builds are not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen ("More info" → "Run anyway") and
macOS Gatekeeper (right-click the app → Open) will ask for confirmation the first time.
